messages:
Jordana (Docs): Heads up — PR #412 for release notes + model catalog changes is ready for review. cc @Mike (Backend) @Sam (Platform)
Mike (Backend): taking a look now. any blockers for merge timing?
Jordana (Docs): want to merge right after smoke deploy tomorrow morning (08:30 PT). Need final approval on migration note wording and SDK snippet.
Sam (Platform): CI preview failed on docs preview: `mkdocs` error — broken anchor on model-table link. I'll attach logs.
docs-ci-bot: build 412-docs-preview failed — linkcheck errors:
```
WARNING - 404 Not Found: /models/catalog#quantized-variants
```
Sasha (PM): That anchor was renamed in model-catalog change. Can we alias or update link?
Jordana (Docs): Update planned. Also the SDK snippet in the migration guide uses `client.generate` but we now recommend `client.chat.create`. Should we keep both?
Mike (Backend): Prefer to show new API only, with a short migration snippet. Example:
```
# before
client.generate(prompt)
# after
client.chat.create(messages=[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"...\"}])
```
Jordana (Docs): I'll patch snippet. Anyone volunteer to be reviewer @Sam?
Sam (Platform): I can review wording and run the preview locally after link fix.
Mike (Backend): I can do a quick API accuracy check. ETA 1h.
Sasha (PM): Note for release notes: mark model v2-alpha as deprecated on 2026-04-15 and add migration steps and recommended alternatives.
Jordana (Docs): Added line to changelog draft. Need sign-off on deprecation date and wording.
Sam (Platform): date ok. Suggest using the term "deprecation" (not "sunset") to match policy.
Jordana (Docs): done. Pushing fix for anchor and snippet now.
docs-ci-bot: build 412-docs-preview — queued
Mike (Backend): LGTM on snippet after small nit (use consistent double quotes) — will open tiny PR to patch.
Jordana (Docs): thanks. If CI passes, merge window tomorrow 09:00 PT. I'll merge then unless blockers.
Sasha (PM): tagging release manager @Lina FYI.
Jordana (Docs): final reminder: add entry in release notes under "Model catalog changes" and link to migration guide: /docs/migration/v2-to-v3
Sam (Platform): preview passed locally. No more broken links.
docs-ci-bot: build 412-docs-preview — success
Jordana (Docs): awesome. merging at 09:00 PT.
Mike (Backend): :thumbsup:
